title: Packaged app can load an arbitrary renderer URL with the privileged preload API
reasoning: createWindow honors ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL regardless of whether the app is packaged, while still attaching the preload that exposes document, backup, restore, update, file-open, and delete operations. If the packaged app is launched with that environment variable pointing at attacker-controlled content, that page receives window.docgit and can invoke local DocGit IPC APIs.
reproduction: Launch the packaged app with ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=https://example.invalid after serving a page that calls window.docgit.listDocuments(); the remote page is loaded with the DocGit bridge instead of the bundled renderer.
recommendation: Gate ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL behind !app.isPackaged and preferably restrict it to localhost development URLs. In packaged builds always load the bundled renderer file.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The boot check loads the bundled renderer file directly and does not exercise the environment-variable branch in a packaged-like mode.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a main-process test or boot check mode that sets ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL while simulating packaged behavior and asserts createWindow still loads the bundled renderer.
minimumFixScope: createWindow renderer URL selection and packaged/dev guard.
